elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: The Company remains prohibited from participating in similar Internet projects, and HDI retains an exclusive right to use the Deerskin brand for the specified site.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The restriction is limited to the defined “Deerskin Products” category and products substantially similar to those products, with illustrative examples.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 expressly applies “for twelve (12) months from the Effective Date,” notwithstanding the Agreement’s automatic renewals.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: The exclusivity ends automatically upon HDI’s failure to meet any service level.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The exclusivity ends automatically upon HDI’s failure to meet any delivery date.
